description: This script measures the performance of various git read-tree and status operations, focusing on index operations and tree traversal. It sets up repositories with specific configurations, executes performance tests, and manages repository state.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with a given description and command.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up a default repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that should succeed, with setup commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
